Leah CSM: Quick heads-up — we need to assemble the Quarterly Health Readout (QHR) for Borealis. Main asks: onboarding status, renewal risk signal, enablement gaps, and 2 exec-level asks. Who can own which slide?
Tom SE: I can take the onboarding slide. Will pull current onboarding tracker + 2 screenshots of the admin console.
Raj AEM: I'll own the renewal-risk slide. Short bullets: usage trend, contract milestone, blockers flagged by ops.
Priya VP-CS: I'll do the exec asks + one-slide summary of mitigation options. Keep it to 3 bullets max.
Leah CSM: Awesome — assign formally: onboarding = @Tom SE, renewal risk = @Raj AEM, exec asks = @Priya VP-CS. I'll capture action items and follow ups.
Tom SE: ETA for my slide: EOD Tuesday. Need a quick confirm on the onboarding metric definitions (active seats vs. enabled seats).
Leah CSM: Use enabled seats for health score. I'll drop the metric mapping in the thread in 10.
Raj AEM: FYI renewal risk score currently 0.6 (yellow). Root cause: delayed integration milestones + missing security signoff. Adding recommended next steps.
Priya VP-CS: For exec asks, prioritize immediate wins that execs can greenlight: 1) dedicated onboarding SOW extension, 2) security review fast-track, 3) success engineering hours.
Leah CSM: Adding enablement coordination: @Tom SE can you call out two enablement sessions we recommend and an estimated hours number? Also capture customer feedback themes from last 3 touchpoints.
Tom SE: Got it — will include: Admin deep-dive (3 hrs), Integration clinic (2 hrs), and a short FAQ doc.
Leah CSM: Quick template for slide owners: 1) 1-line summary, 2) top 3 data points, 3) 2 recommended actions, 4) owner + ETA. Keeps exec slide deck tight.
engage-bot: Reminder: QHR deck deadline in 72 hours — upload to /shared/qhrs/borealis by 1745083200
Raj AEM: Capturing one feedback theme: "slow support turnaround on security questions" — will add verbatim quote and timestamped ticket ref.
Priya VP-CS: Can we include a short risks->impact->ask table on the renewal slide? That format landed well last quarter.
Leah CSM: Yes — use: Risk | Likely impact | Ask (owner). I'll draft base table and ping reviewers.
Tom SE: Small ask — can product ops provide an updated SLA baseline line item? I'll loop in product-ops if needed.
Leah CSM: I'll loop product-ops and legal for the security signoff path. Action log: (1) Tom: onboarding slide by EOD Tue; (2) Raj: renewal slide + quotes by Wed AM; (3) Priya: exec asks slide by Wed AM; (4) Leah: compile deck + risk table by Wed EOD.
Raj AEM: +1 on dates. Also suggest a 15-min dry run Thurs morning with execs present.
Priya VP-CS: +1 — schedule dry run after we have all slides.
Leah CSM: I'll create a calendar invite. Anyone else wants a follow-up item added?
Tom SE: Add a short appendix slide with rollout timeline and who owns next-steps.
Leah CSM: Noted. Thanks all — will post draft link when the first two slides are in. :thumbsup:
